title: glydraw as a ggplot2 extension
text: Let’s start simplest function, geom_glycan(). similar geom_text() geom_label(), plots glycan cartoons instead text. Therefore, need provide third aesthetic addition x y, namely structure, just provide label geom_text().  structure aesthetic can character vector supported glyparse::auto_parse(), example . can also glyrepr::glycan_structure() vector. Technically, can provide structure aesthetic ggplot(), recommend using geom_glycan(), geoms simply ignore structure. Keeping geom_glycan() also makes code readable. may also noticed geom_glycan() inherits styling arguments draw_cartoon(). often need adjust arguments, placing glycan cartoons figure requires careful attention ensure look good alongside components. universal defaults. little creativity, geom_glycan() can used create variety plots.
code: plot_data <- tibble(   glycan = c("Gal(b1-3)GalNAc(a1-", "Gal(b1-3)[GlcNAc(b1-6)]GalNAc(a1-"),   value = c(1, 2), )  ggplot(plot_data, aes(glycan, value)) +   geom_col(fill = "grey70") +   # ===== Important Here =====   geom_glycan(     aes(structure = glycan),  # provide a `structure` aesthetic     orient = "up",             # set orientation to vertical     size = 0.5,               # default 1 is too large     vjust = 0,                # aligned to bottom     position = position_nudge(y = 0.1)   ) +   # ==========================   scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.4))) +   theme_classic() +   theme(     axis.text.x = element_blank(),     axis.ticks.x = element_blank()   ) # Don't do this ggplot(aes(x, y, structure = glycan)) +   geom_glycan()  # Do this ggplot(aes(x, y)) +   geom_glycan(aes(structure = glycan)) plot_data <- tibble(   y = 0,   x = 1:5,   glycan = c(     "Glc(a1-",     "Glc(a1-3)Glc(a1-",     "Glc(a1-3)Glc(a1-3)Glc(a1-",     "Glc(a1-3)Glc(a1-3)Glc(a1-3)Glc(a1-",     "Glc(a1-3)Glc(a1-3)Glc(a1-3)Glc(a1-3)Glc(a1-"   ), )  ggplot(plot_data, aes(x, y)) +   # ===== Important Here =====   geom_glycan(     aes(structure = glycan),     size = 0.7,     vjust = 0,     orient = "up"   ) +   # ==========================   geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +   geom_point() +   scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.5))) +   theme_void()
